source_text: Filii Israelitidis et Aegyptii qui nomen maledixit. Historia aperta; sensus interior laborat. Mixto corde blasphemia nascitur.
pass_a_gloss: Of-son of-Israelite-woman and of-Egyptian who name cursed. History open; sense interior labors. With-mixed heart blasphemy is-born.
pass_b_english: The son of an [[Israelite woman and an Egyptian father cursed the Name >> Bible:Leviticus 24:10-11]]. The story is open; the inner sense costs labor. A mixed heart breeds blasphemy.
